value.snippet: Video: 00:01:00 This video was published on social media by ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot with the following caption: [ version FR ] Day 222, orbit 3442 — More vacuum cleaning in space! Keeping the ventilation grids clean is essential in an environment like ours, where the air is continuously recycled in a near-closed-loop system. Much like on a submarine, or a climate-controlled laboratory, clean airflow isn't just a matter of comfort, it's an important part of keeping both the crew and the Station running smoothly. Science, operations, exercise... our days on the International Space Station are busy and maintenance is part of the routine too. Everyone gets their share of housekeeping duties! -- Jour 222, orbite 3442 – Encore une séquence d’aspirateur dans l’espace ! Dans un environnement comme le notre, où l’air est continuellement recyclé dans un système presque en circuit fermé, il est absolument essentiel de garder les grilles de ventilation propres. Un peu comme à bord d’un sous-ma
value.title: Vacuuming the ventilation grids in Columbus
